title: Confirmation statement (CS01c)
text:
This form confirms that your company’s details are up to date on the Companies House register.

 It costs £110 to file your confirmation statement on paper.

 It’s quicker and easier to  file your confirmation statement online .

 Changes to your company information

 Use parts 1 to 4 to make changes to the company’s:

 • principal business activities or standard industrial classification (SIC)

 • statement of capital

 • trading status of shares and exemption from providing people with significant control (PSC) information

 • shareholder information

 Use the  condensed list of SIC codes  if you need to update your nature of business activity on your confirmation statement.

 Registered email address

 You must use part 5 to provide a registered email address if you have not already provided one.

 There’s a different process if you need to  change your company’s registered email address .

 Identity verification

 You must give the identity verification details for all your current directors, unless you have already provided this information. See  Verifying your identity for Companies House .
